Abans Financial Services Limited
(Formerly known as Abans Holdings Limited)

Notes to the unaudited Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026:

1.The above unaudited financial results have been prepared in accordance with regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

2.The above unaudited consolidated financial results are prepared to comply in all material respect in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS) notified under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, read with relevant rules issued there under. These unaudited consolidated financial results were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 11, 2026. These results for the half year ended September 30, 2026 have been subject to limited review by the Statutory Auditors of the Company who has issued an unmodified review report thereon.

3.During the period ended September 30, 2026, the Company has allotted 556,284 equity shares (Face value of Rs. 2/- each) pursuant to the exercise of options granted under Employee Stock Option Scheme.

4.As on September 30, 2026, the Company has fourteen subsidiaries (including step down subsidiaries).

5.On August 06, 2025, the Board of Directors of Abans Broking Services Private Limited (ABSPL) has approved Proposal of scheme of arrangement of merger, where in Abans Capital Private Limited (Transferor) (Holding Company), Abans Securities Private Limited (Transferor), Abans Commodities (I) Private Limited (Transferor), and Clamant Broking Services Private Limited (Transferor) will merge with ABSPL (Transferee), The Scheme of Amalgamation has been approved by Stock Exchange(s) and the Company has filled an appropriate application before the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal on July 16, 2026. On October 22, 2026, The Mumbai Bench of the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal issued an order admitting the Scheme Application and directing the Transferor and Transferee Companies to serve notices to the appropriate sectoral/regulatory authorities and obtain their no-objection for the proposed merger. Currently, the transferor and transferee are in the process of serving the said notices to the appropriate sectoral/regulatory authorities.

6.The Group’s operating segments are established on the basis of those components of the Group that are evaluated regularly by the chief operating decision maker in deciding how to allocate resources and in assessing performance. These have been identified taking into account nature of activity, the differing risks and returns and the internal business reporting systems.

The Group has the following principal operating and reporting segments; viz. Fee based investment services, Principal investment & Treasury and Lending & Credit solutions. The accounting policies adopted for segment reporting are in line with the accounting policy of the Company and the Statement on Segment Reporting is as per Ind AS – 108- Operating Segments.

9.The figures of the quarter ended September 30, 2026, are the balancing figures between the reviewed figures for the half year ended September 30, 2026, and reviewed figures in respect of quarter ended June 30, 2026. The figures for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, are the balancing figures between the reviewed figures of the half year ended September 30, 2025, and reviewed figures in respect of quarter ended June 30, 2025.

10.Figures are regrouped, rearranged and reclassified wherever necessary.
